### Root Cause
In [`Partial`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/time_1_group_a_blind/src/main/java/org/joda/time/Partial.java#L189-L245), constructor validation checks that field types are ordered from largest to smallest using `lastUnitField.compareTo(loopUnitField)`. When an unsupported duration field (such as `eras()`, represented by [`UnsupportedDurationField`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/time_1_group_a_blind/src/main/java/org/joda/time/field/UnsupportedDurationField.java#L226-L231)) was compared against a supported duration field (like `year()`), `UnsupportedDurationField.getUnitMillis()` returned `0`, causing the preceding supported unit field to evaluate as larger than the unsupported field. Additionally, `UnsupportedDurationField.compareTo` improperly returned `1` when comparing against supported fields.

### Fix
1. In [`Partial.java`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/time_1_group_a_blind/src/main/java/org/joda/time/Partial.java#L217-L230), added explicit validation to ensure that if an unsupported duration field follows a supported duration field, an `IllegalArgumentException` is thrown indicating improper order ("largest-smallest"). If multiple unsupported duration fields are encountered, a duplicate unsupported exception is thrown. Also ensured that range comparison only proceeds when unit fields are equal (`lastUnitField.equals(loopUnitField)`).
2. In [`UnsupportedDurationField.java`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/time_1_group_a_blind/src/main/java/org/joda/time/field/UnsupportedDurationField.java#L226-L228), removed the condition that returned `1` when compared against a supported duration field, restoring the contract that `compareTo` returns `0` always.

### Verification
The test `org.joda.time.TestPartial_Constructors::testConstructorEx7_TypeArray_intArray` now passes with 0 failures, and the focused patch has been saved to [`blind_fix.patch`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/time_1_group_a_blind/blind_fix.patch).
